## Version impact

- [ ] Patch: minor update or fix
- [ ] Minor: big feature
- [ ] Major: wide feature release, upgrade or incompatible save

## Checklist

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under Unreleased (or this body says `changelog: none`)
- [ ] Tests cover the change with independently worked expectations
- [ ] `docs/planning/STATUS.md` and requirement evidence updated if a requirement moved
- [ ] Canonical hash re-pinned in Rust and Swift if world state changed
